# Relay Capture

> Relay Capture is an asynchronous B2B pipeline infrastructure and automated deliverability architecture designed for post-seed to Series A SaaS companies and high-ticket B2B agencies ($3k–$15k ACV).

## Overview
Relay Capture eliminates silent outbound pipeline decay and deliverability failures. The platform provides automated DMARC/DKIM/SPF cryptographic alignment, real-time quarantine monitoring, data enrichment routing, and sub-15-second inbound pipeline interception to protect enterprise domain reputation and recover lost revenue leakage.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deliverability & Reputation Guard:** Continuous RFC 7489 authentication monitoring, spam quarantine mitigation, and domain burnout prevention.
- **Asymmetric Pipeline Exposure Modeling:** Mathematical risk calculators projecting annualized pipeline leakage based on outbound volume and quarantine rates.
- **High-Leverage Pipeline Routing:** Asynchronous webhook ingestion, data enrichment, and automated lead routing for high-ticket sales teams.

## Architecture & Integration
- **Zero-Latency Ingestion:** Connects directly via webhooks, REST APIs, and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce).
- **Authentication Standards:** Native enforcement of strict DMARC (`p=reject`/`p=quarantine`), SPF hardfail resolution, and 2048-bit DKIM rotation.

## Target Audience
- Post-seed and Series A B2B SaaS founders.
- High-ticket B2B agencies and enterprise sales organizations ($3k–$15k ACV).
- Revenue Operations (RevOps) and Sales Operations leaders managing cold outbound infrastructure (>10k sends/month).
